data.body:
Root cause found, 2026-11-05 (read-only production measurements; fix in review).

## Observation
- Production 2026-11-04 timing lines: the `ledger` phase was 157-277 s of each 158-278 s hold (folds 7773, 1a3b, 26a0, 578a, fb16).
- In the MCP container, on a `git clone --shared --no-checkout` of the live tracker (reads the same object store, writes nothing to it), the exact per-ticket walk `build_ticket_position_commit_map` runs took 160.8 s for 26a0-0104-9b63-4500 (its fold's ledger: 165.50 s) and 266.1 s for fb16-a8b0-c2b7-449a (ledger: 277.48 s).
- The store-wide walk `build_position_commit_map` (the sweep's shared map) took 427.5 s there. Its subprocess timeout is 300 s.
- On the operator clone the same walks take 111 s (store-wide) and 19.1 s (26a0 per-ticket).

## Cause
`build_position_commit_map` times out in production and returns `{}`, so `compact._sweep_position_map` returns `None`. With no map, `_sweep_one_ticket` skips pre-resolution and `_build_authorship_ledger` builds the per-ticket map itself, inside `_fold_under_lock`, under the store write lock. That one `git log --full-history` walk is the ledger phase. The clone replay never reached this branch because its store-wide walk finished inside 300 s. The single-ticket `rebar store compact <id>` path always passed no map, so it always walked under the lock.

## Fix (change pending)
`_compact_locked` resolves positions before `lock.acquire`, like attribution and signers: new `preresolve_positions` builds the per-ticket map when none was passed and fills misses through `preresolve_unmapped_positions`. `_sweep_one_ticket` no longer pre-resolves (the fold does it). The timing line gains a `positions` phase, timed before the lock. No config key, env var, flag or lock added.

Tests (tests/unit/test_compact_sweep_perf.py), RED before the fix with `build_ticket_position_commit_map` observed under the lock, GREEN after:
- `test_a_timed_out_sweep_map_runs_no_history_walk_under_the_lock` (store-wide walk raises TimeoutExpired, as in production)
- `test_the_single_ticket_fold_runs_no_history_walk_under_the_lock`

## Separate
Why production git is 4-8x slower than a clone is filed as nickelic-lazuline-gonolek (74,605 loose objects / 8.63 GiB, 235 packs, commit-graph from 2026-08-31). This fix moves the walk out of the lock; it does not make the walk faster.
